# Bundled lettering font

Author: Codex app agent · 2026-09-11.

Unmodified Helvetiker Regular from Three.js r176, 63,182 bytes. Original Magenta copyright and MgOpen permission terms are retained in `LICENSE` and in the typeface JSON. Source and SHA-256 are recorded in `../manifest.json`. The font JSON is fetched locally only when a label is requested.

`three/FontLoader.js` and the converter-only `three/SVGLoader.js` are unmodified official r176 examples modules, under the Three.js MIT license in `three/LICENSE`:

- https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r176/examples/jsm/loaders/FontLoader.js
- https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r176/examples/jsm/loaders/SVGLoader.js
- https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r176/examples/fonts/helvetiker_regular.typeface.json

No external font service or font substitution. Unsupported characters are rejected before placement. Text size is the em size, not a promise of a particular cap height or minimum stroke width.
